title: Anthropic's S-1 lists 94 pages of risk factors and warns that the "scale of harm" from a "catastrophic" AI incident might mean it is unable to obtain insurance (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Anthropic's S-1 lists 94 pages of risk factors and warns that the “scale of harm” from a “catastrophic” AI incident might mean it is unable to obtain insurance — 94 pages — Nearly a quarter of Anthropic's S1, or 94 pages, was dedicated to risk factors …
contentText:
Wall Street Journal :

Anthropic's S-1 lists 94 pages of risk factors and warns that the “scale of harm” from a “catastrophic” AI incident might mean it is unable to obtain insurance   —  94 pages  —  Nearly a quarter of Anthropic's S1, or 94 pages, was dedicated to risk factors …
